research_decision: Do not promote either CPU control or repeat Qwen training with this penalty alone. The penalty control abstained on every case and missed every opportunity; reducing false calls by becoming idle is not a trading edge.
summary: Added and tested a fixed false-direction objective with natural training frequencies. Two bounded CPU fits completed and were checked on every inner-check example. A separate timestamp-only audit establishes that the existing sparse Qwen examples cannot supply 5/15/30-second temporal context. No Qwen training, trading, threshold tuning or reserved evaluation occurred.

data.exposure: Already-exposed within-training temporal development, not an independent holdout. These check sessions and labels have been examined by previous studies.
data.target: 6E futures crossed-quote class after 100ms delayed entry and 15s hold with 1/2/4 extra round-trip ticks; not EUR/USD CFD fills, trade returns or portfolio PnL
data.observability_limitation: Only causally eligible resolved examples with acceptable outcomes are in this supervised file. Unavailable/uncertain outcomes remain excluded rather than negative labels, and selection bias is not removed by natural class frequencies.

preregistered_objective.formula: Mean joint cross entropy + strength * softmax-expected class penalty + 0.5 * 0.01 * squared weight norm
preregistered_objective.penalty_units: Arbitrary research units averaged across three cost classes; not measured monetary costs or three independent trade returns
preregistered_objective.sampling: All inner-fit examples at natural frequencies; no balancing, class weights, minority oversampling or check-data fitting
preregistered_objective.optimization: 200 full-batch epochs, learning rate 0.05, L2 0.01, standardized clipping at 10, zero weights and Laplace-smoothed natural log priors
preregistered_objective.normalization: Inner-fit population means/std only, constant columns use scale one
preregistered_objective.decision_rule: Same coherent joint-state argmax with fixed tie order for both controls. No decision threshold, early stopping, search, retry or winner selection.
preregistered_objective.probability_warning: Risk-regularized softmax values are not calibrated market probabilities

natural_cross_entropy.interpretation: Matches the earlier unweighted CPU control numerically. Only 12 directional predictions are too sparse to establish a usable frequent-trading strategy or economic edge.

natural_direction_penalty.interpretation: Lower expected class penalty but worse log loss/Brier and no opportunity detection. Its discrete predictions equal the idle controls; not an improved trading model.

results.reporting: Full pooled and all 28 per-session confusions, support, precision/recall and penalties are retained in the pinned local run receipt. No model was selected for promotion.

causal_history_feasibility.audit_inputs: Role, dated session/contract and decision timestamp only; no feature, prompt or target access in the audit
causal_history_feasibility.semantics: Timestamp-only upper bound on prior observed decisions in [now-window, now); reset on source session or gap >5s, exclude current until after counting
causal_history_feasibility.conclusion: Neither partition has any preceding row within the intended 5/15/30-second history windows. Do not interpolate, forward-fill or mislabel minute-spaced examples as a temporal order-book encoder.
causal_history_feasibility.audit_limit: The dense engine also resets on causal prior-quote gaps. Timestamp presence alone would not establish usable context; the zero upper bound here does establish its absence in the sparse file.
causal_history_feasibility.existing_dense_engine: causal_6e_context.py already supports receive-time past-only snapshot means, current-minus-past changes, sample counts, spans and session/gap resets. Prior dense context-tree results selected no trades; context presence alone has not proven an edge.

post_run_dense_availability_check.limitation: Metadata and regular-file presence only. A future authorized builder must hash and validate every consumed shard; this check does not establish fresh content integrity or performance.

verified_execution.cpu_environment: Original CPU .venv: Python 3.12.10 Windows AMD64, NumPy 2.5.3

next_separately_bounded_step.development: Create a versioned, train-only context-to-Qwen dataset builder using existing pinned one-second processed rows. Construct history sequentially within each source_session/contract, then attach it to the unchanged eligible sixty-second decision cases. Do not create context from sparse supervised rows or use target availability as an input.
next_separately_bounded_step.verification: Prove prefix invariance, exact expiry, gap/session/contract resets, missing-history encoding and future-field independence. Keep unknown outcomes unknown, preserve whole-session fit/check isolation, and bind each example to its dense source and original sparse case.
next_separately_bounded_step.model_before_training: Define compact causal features and an explicit versioned task; run tokenizer-only context/sequence preflight. Freeze a new representative-prior curriculum and evaluation before any native training. No automatic resume of the rejected adapter.
next_separately_bounded_step.gates: Context features are another research hypothesis, not confirmed icebergs or a profitability guarantee. Need adequate supported directional detection and executable costs/risk validation; do not loosen the current safeguards or open reserved 2026 labels.
